crossRefs.note: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels…
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…
Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

translations.web: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
translations.bsb: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
translations.kjv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain
translations.asv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.
